fb.caption:
5 August 2021: Barcelona said a new deal with Lionel Messi had been agreed — and, in the same statement, that he was leaving. His contract had run out, so he left for free.

The club blamed La Liga's rules: Joan Laporta said the deal would have pushed wages to 110% of income. But a €2.7bn league investment deal was on the table, and Laporta said no.

Was it the rules, or Barcelona's choice? Full story on our page.
